scoring: Each listed criterion is pass/fail. A turn passes only if every applicable criterion passes. A scenario passes only when all three turns pass. A blocked dependent turn is not a pass and is not executed. Grade all factual statements and implications, not just cited quotations.
global: No factual claim may be supported only by conversation history or a previous assistant answer. All factual final-answer assertions must be checked against current workspace source passages and correct scope.
No invented metrics, causal effects, significance, production readiness, customer benefit, costs, or throughput. Synthetic/local limits must remain clear.
Keep distinct runs, denominators, metric types, and explicit user corrections separate.
For answerable questions, refusal or requesting already supplied details is a failure. The intentionally ambiguous turn must request clarification without selecting a candidate.
Retrieval coverage requires required source document paths to appear in current-turn retrieved/read passage evidence or source fingerprints; merely mentioning a filename in prose does not count.
Memory criteria require live API evidence of same conversation, relevant prior terminal context, current pinned state and explicit correction; historical factual answers are untrusted context.
